study: V99 R66 hedge-amplitude regime audit: h0.25 vs h0.15
objective: identify causal regimes in which the stronger R55 h0.25 hedge outperforms h0.15 over the next 24h/72h, using a fixed chronological 60/40 split, so a future router can seek h0.15 one-year upside and h0.25 historical/severe robustness
disclosure: Diagnostic historical research only. Future h0.25-vs-h0.15 relative return is used only as a label. All features and train-derived thresholds use information available at each observation; holdout is chronological and untouched by threshold fitting.
